settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Theme, language and display preferences are saved on this device and applied immediately.
settings.appearanceDesc: Auto follows your device's light or dark setting.
settings.glassDesc: Tune the transparency and blur of glass surfaces. Turn it off for solid surfaces.
settings.glassEnableHint: Give the header, cards and floating controls a translucent glass finish
settings.glassBlurHint: Higher values blur the background more
settings.glassPreviewText: Drag the sliders to preview the liquid-glass effect live.
settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language. Follow region uses your device time zone.
settings.resetHint: Restore follow-device language and auto theme.
settings.previewText: This is an interface preview. Switching theme or language updates every supported area immediately.
settings.languageNote: Language affects global navigation, the home page and this settings page; platform content keeps its original language.
